name: Moonburst
body:
School evocation [cold, light]; Level druid/shaman 7, witch 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a claw)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 60-foot burst
Duration Instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create an explosive globe of moonlight in the area, dealing 1d6 cold damage per level (maximum 20d6) to all creatures in the area. If the affected creature is undead or has DR that is bypassed by silver, this spell instead deals 1d8 untyped damage per class level (maximum 20d8). A successful Fortitude save halves the damage.

If there is a darkness or deeper darkness spell or similar effect within the radius, it is dispelled.
